elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added language begins: “Upon expiry or termination for any reason.”
Licensor, corresponding to Vendor, must “provide reasonable transition assistance” at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to 6 months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states “at Licensor’s then-current rates.”
Licensor must “return to Licensee all Licensee data,” including specified trade, client, and account records.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The return obligation must be performed “within thirty (30) days” under the expiry-or-termination trigger.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable format requirement.

elements.element: Vendor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After the return obligation, Licensor must “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after deleting Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Licensor must “certify such deletion in writing” after the data-return step.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “[u]pon expiry or termination for any reason.”
Licensor must provide reasonable transition assistance at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months encompasses the fallback requirement of 90 days.
The requirement to return all Licensee data in a commonly used, machine-readable format constitutes a data export.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The machine-readable return is expressly required within thirty days under the expiry-or-termination trigger.

result.reason: The added operative language covers every preferred requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It is directed to the correct party, includes both expiry and termination, and states the required durations, rates, format, deletion, and certification duties. The amendment is confined to transition and data-return matters and does not contradict the existing return-of-Licensor-materials obligation. Drafting is clear, although “up to six months” and “thereafter” leave some timing discretion.
